title: Pixel-art dungeon floor of irregular stone slabs
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art flagstone floor at a chosen art resolution: random-ashlar slabs of one or two cells with dark joints, lit and shadow bevels, chipped corners, branching cracks, moss in the joints and glossy puddles, with per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for dungeon floors.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_dungeon_floor.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: cells
parameters.meaning: Layout cells across the tile; slabs span one or two cells each way.

parameters.name: large_slabs
parameters.meaning: Chance that a slab spans two cells (0 is a square grid of slabs).

parameters.name: cracks
parameters.meaning: Share of slabs with a crack.

parameters.name: chips
parameters.meaning: Chance that a slab corner is chipped.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Grey dungeon slabs with cracks, chipped corners and a little moss.

presets.name: mossy_crypt
presets.description: Green-grey crypt floor overgrown with moss in every joint.

presets.name: sandstone_temple
presets.description: Warm sandstone temple slabs, large and tidy.

presets.name: flooded_cellar
presets.description: Dark cellar flagstones with glossy puddles.

limits: Stylized pixel art with the light from the top left baked into the slab bevels. Slabs are rectangles on a coarse grid of cells, one or two cells each way, so the layout has no curved or diagonal joints, and a grid of two cells makes plain square slabs. Cracks are random walks and puddles thresholded noise. Roughness and height are values per drawn class, and the normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Greedy random-ashlar packing of cells on a torus
Joint ownership on the top and left edge of each slab
Bevel shading with highlight and shadow rows
Thresholded fractal noise for moss and puddles
